snippet.title: Pieced Together/ Walkies - CodeCoven Montage
snippet.description:
Check out these two cozy games from Code Coven!

Pieced Together - Step into a beautifully illustrated scrapbook and revisit the story of lifelong friends Connie and Beth. In this cozy puzzle game you’ll sort items, solve gentle puzzles and decorate each page as the years unfold. As Connie reflects on a friendship and questions whether to hold on or let go you’ll carry the emotional weight of each memory and discover a story about growing older, change and connection.

Walkies - Grab the leash and bound into adventure as Bailey, a rescue beagle on a mission to save the animal sanctuary at Mighty Oaks. Explore open-seasons of Summer, Autumn, Winter and Spring, help critters with quirky tasks, run, jump, swim, sniff your way through fields and forests and uncover the mystery behind a stranger’s sabotage. Switch up your style with fun costumes and lead the pack in this family friendly, story-rich dog-led exploration game.
